title: Corporate Sales Terms: Agreement Benefits on Crestline Tickets
content:
**Corporate Sales terms — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A ticket whose corporate agreement field names a Crestline corporate travel agreement receives that agreement's benefits:

1. **Change fees.** When the agreement tier waives change fees in the corporate agreement terms, no change fee or same-day change fee is charged.
2. **Checked bags.** The tier's corporate checked-bag allowance competes with the fare brand and Summit allowances under the most-generous-allowance rule.
3. **Reassignment.** When the tier allows name changes between travelers, an unflown ticket may be reassigned to another traveler on the agreement's active roster. This is the only exception to the rule that a ticket is never transferred.

## Conditions

- Corporate benefits are applied only while the business agreement named on the ticket has status active; the status is read from the agreement's own record.
- Award tickets, companion tickets and Crestline Basic Economy tickets never carry a corporate agreement and never receive corporate benefits, even when the traveler appears on a corporate roster.
- Corporate waivers and Summit elite waivers of the same fee do not stack into a credit; a fee waived by either is simply not charged.

| Hypothetical ticket | Agreement status | Corporate benefits |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Main Cabin booked under an agreement | Active | Applied |
| Crestline Main Cabin booked under an agreement | Not active | Not applied |
| Crestline Basic Economy, traveler on a roster | Any | Never applied |
| Change fee waived by both the agreement and the Summit tier | Active | Fee not charged; no credit arises |
